evidence.observation: Tube pressure rises monotonically through growth, 3.19→3.53 Torr (k=20..26), while Ar setpoint and flow are constant at 100 sccm
MFC steady at ~99-100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~44%, so the drift is not thermal
o2_exhaust not installed; atmosphere purity/leak status cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or an equivalent leak check) plus a flow-step / pump-isolation rate-of-rise test to distinguish a downstream exhaust blockage from an air leak into the tube.
